scope: Targeted UE1 file-format specification audit of active parser and UEDB5 table bridge. Adds evidence to existing ue1-tables contract; not a new acceptance case or global Epic certification.

verified_fixes.rule: Selected Unreal v1.200 name operator reads at most 63 bytes without requiring on-disk trailing zero; UT99 v400 reads NUL-terminated names before v64
verified_fixes.actual_before: 63-byte original Unreal-style v61 name consumed a zero from Flags and failed at file EOF
verified_fixes.actual_after: 63-byte Unreal source-style and 63-byte UT99 NUL-terminated cases each decoded name length 63 and Flags=458752

verified_fixes.rule: Signed compact-index magnitude fits the represented signed int32
verified_fixes.actual_after: 0, positive max, negative min accepted; positive and negative overflows rejected

verified_fixes.rule: Versions below 34 have a different summary layout
verified_fixes.actual_after: Pre-v34 header fails closed with distinct diagnostic

verified_original_files.result: 34 names/3 imports/16 exports; selected-source parse identical to prior baseline

unresolved_findings.finding: Unreal 227k conditional archetype layout is gated by a single game-wide v227 summary Boolean, not independently authenticated runtime build identity
unresolved_findings.action: split summary source/version from compiled 227k FObjectExport dispatch; require explicit runtime provenance/diagnostic ambiguity

unresolved_findings.finding: UE1 Unreal UEDB5 table snapshot builder discards parsed archetypeIndex despite reader retaining it
unresolved_findings.action: version the export snapshot schema for optional archetype-index field and plan scoped resnapshot

unresolved_findings.finding: UEDB5 name snapshot stores normalized text and flags but not original serialized name bytes or code-unit width
unresolved_findings.action: preserve raw names in versioned snapshot if byte-for-byte standalone roundtripping is required

unresolved_findings.finding: Direct no-profile parser constructions cannot always choose v1.200 vs UT99 pre64 name operator without known game-loader provenance
unresolved_findings.action: explicit game/source argument at direct diagnostics where required
